400 Bad Request when image generation parameters are invalid

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from liter_llm import create_client
from liter_llm._internal_bindings import CreateImageRequest
from liter_llm import BadRequestError, LiterLlmError

async def main() -> None:
    try:
        client = create_client(api_key=os.environ["API_KEY"])
        request = CreateImageRequest.from_json("{\"model\":\"dall-e-3\",\"n\":1,\"prompt\":\"A cat\",\"size\":\"9999x9999\"}")
        await client.image_generate(request)
    except BadRequestError as error:
        print(f"BadRequestError: {error}")
    except LiterLlmError as error:
        print(f"{type(error).__name__}: {error}")

asyncio.run(main())
```
